title: Doty's claim he was an Area 51 guard

tellings.quote: He said he was a guard at Area 51. I have no idea.

plain: A man named Rick Doty has said that he once worked as a guard at Area 51, a secret Air Force test site in Nevada. The writer Greg Bishop passes on the claim to Michels, adding at once: "I have no idea." Bishop leaves it there and neither backs the claim nor rejects it, though if true it would put Doty inside one of the most guarded places in the country.
